Receipts + Assay

Vendor claims against independent sources, with a substring gate

  1. What it is
  2. What exists
  3. What was measured
  4. What was not measured or built
  5. Known weaknesses and negative results
  6. Open questions
  7. Evidence

What it is

  • Receipts is a TypeScript pipeline that reads a vendor's pages and independent sources (including SEC filings, NHTSA and IIHS), lets a model propose which claims contradict which, and discards any quote a deterministic gate cannot re-find in the fetched bytes. #receipts-pipeline
  • Assay is the claim-audit constraint layer extracted from Receipts into a standalone TypeScript library (v0.1.0): corpus plus subject in, a ledger or a reasoned refusal out. #assay-library

#receipts-tesla-ledger BUILT LINKED as of 2026-09-30

The Tesla FSD ledger has no DIVERGENT or corroborated row; its strongest rows are two DISPUTED ones, such as Tesla's FSD page ('helping make the roads safer') against NHTSA recall 23V-085 ('increases the risk of a crash').

Reported numbers
Numbers for receipts-tesla-ledger
MetricValuen / denominatorDatasetSyntheticSystemDate
ledger rows by statusunverified 4, disputed 2, context_unverified 2, divergent 08 rows11 pages fetched live 2026-09-30 (Tesla pages, 10-K, NHTSA, IIHS, others)noReceipts, claude-opus-5 proposer, two samples, relation check on2026-09-30
Does not show
A measured refutation. The README: the recall sentence states no test or measurement, and it concerns FSD Beta in 2023, not today's FSD (Supervised). 'Read it as a regulator pushing back.'
Sources disagree
The seed says Receipts 'surfaced a Tesla disclosure divergence'. The committed ledger has zero divergent rows. An earlier ledger had one divergent row; the README says it was removed because it rested on a Wikipedia sentence cut off mid-way, whose full text was about a benchmark, not a collision rate. The repo wins.

Known weaknesses and negative results

#receipts-relation-check NEGATIVE-RESULT AUTHOR-REPORTED as of 2026-09-30

A frontier-model check that admits a relation only when both quotes measure the same thing failed its bar: it denied all 30 labeled no-relation pairs but admitted only 2 of 5 real ones.

Verification
Author-reported, not re-verified. No tier-1 artifact containing this claim was opened for this site.
